description: Use to find companies that meet conditions (cheap, high dividend, fast growth…). Filter and rank the covered universe (about 4,000 US-listed names) on fundamental fields (marketCap, peRatio, dividendYield, consecutiveYears, margins, 5y CAGRs, …). Returns at most 25 rows — the MCP tier's cap; the full screener lives at https://tgmcharts.com/screener. Units: yields, margins, growth and CAGRs are fractions, not percents (dividendYield gt 0.03 = above 3%; see the field description). Example: filters [{field: "dividendYield", operator: "gt", value: 0.03}, {field: "consecutiveYears", operator: "gte", value: 25}], sortBy "dividendYield".

field.description: Field to filter on. Units: dividendYield, netProfitMargin, grossMargin, revenueGrowth (TTM), priceChange1Y and the *Cagr5y fields are fractions (0.03 = 3%); percentFrom52WeekHigh and percentFrom52WeekLow are percents (-12.5 = 12.5% below the high); marketCap is in the quote currency (US dollars for US listings); peRatio and debtToEquity are ratios; consecutiveYears is years of dividend increases; symbol, name and sector are text (eq / neq).

format.description: json (default): the full JSON as text. markdown: a compact table or list, fewer tokens. structuredContent is the full JSON either way.
